$description: NCSSM YAC colour tokens. Blue and Orange are NCSSM's official brand colours (NCSSM Communications Kiosk, Brand & Logos). The YAC way of using them, plus the neutrals and dark surfaces, comes from the Claude Design slide decks (YAC Biweekly Sept 23 and Oct 7, Yakety AI Coding Workshop). Contrast ratios are WCAG 2.x against the background named.

blue.usage: NCSSM primary. Cover and section-divider backgrounds, labels and eyebrows on light slides, callout panels, agenda numbers.

orange.usage: NCSSM accent and the YAC's signature accent. The catalyst dot, 6px accent rules, the highlighted agenda item, big numbers, the Catalyst glow. Shapes and display text only on light backgrounds (2.8:1 on Paper).

orange-deep.usage: Orange for small text on light backgrounds (dates and highlights under 36px bold). New: not yet used in a deck.

midnight.usage: Body text on light slides. Background for the Catalyst slides, photo grids and media frames.

paper.usage: Default slide background. Text colour on Blue and Midnight.

white.usage: Cards and panels that sit on Paper.

mist.usage: Hairline rules under column headers, pill outlines, dashed placeholder borders, chart baselines.

fog.usage: Outlined-card borders and placeholder image fills.

blue-tint.usage: Chart bars that aren't the highlight.

blue-deep.usage: Image frame behind text on Blue section dividers (before the photo is dropped in).

night.usage: Photo placeholders and raised surfaces on Midnight.

rule-on-blue.usage: 2px rule between the title block and the footer block on covers.

cool-gray.usage: NCSSM's second primary colour. Not used in YAC decks so far; Slate does the grey work there.

light-blue.usage: NCSSM accent. Not yet used by the YAC.

purple.usage: NCSSM accent. Not yet used by the YAC.

gold.usage: NCSSM accent. Not yet used by the YAC.

green.usage: NCSSM accent; close to the Morganton Dragon green. Not yet used by the YAC.

catalyst-glow.usage: Box shadow on the large Catalyst reveal circle.

catalyst-glow-small.usage: Box shadow on the small Catalyst tease dot.
